events.title: Proposed ruling: refund_full $6.61 (model confidence 0.96)
events.body: The driver cancelled this RydeX trip and kept the $6.61 cancellation fee on the ground that the rider was a no-show [F3][F6]. Under NS-0 the case therefore enters through NS-1/NS-2 [F3][NS-0]. NS-1 requires all three elements: an arrival confirmation, GPS placing the driver at the pickup point at the moment of the tap, and a continuous wait of more than 3 minutes inside the pickup radius until cancelling [F5][F4][NS-1]. Only the first element is satisfied — the driver tapped "I'm Here" at 12:06:15 [F5][NS-1]. On the second, the tap was made 600 m from the pickup point, the driver's closest approach in the whole trip was 599 m, and the platform never recorded him at the pickup point [F5][F1][F4][NS-1]. On the third, he spent 0 s continuously within 200 m of the pickup after the tap, far short of the 180 s threshold, though he sat stationary 600 m away from 12:05:55 to 12:09:25 [F5][F2][NS-1]. NS-1 (ii) and (iii) therefore both fail, and NS-2 requires the $6.61 to be refunded in full [F5][F1][F3][NS-1][NS-2]. The chat confirms the rider was actually at the pickup point while the driver asserted he was "here already" from elsewhere [F8][F9][F10]. Because the driver pressed the arrival button while GPS showed him outside the pickup range, the case additionally carries a flag_account action under NS-2 [F5][F1][NS-2]. The refund is a single fixed item of $6.61 taken from the fare record, so the amount is $6.61, not a per-km computation [F3][F6][NS-2], and is issued as a Ryde voucher under NS-7 [NS-7]. The traffic and weather records (band 3 on Jalan Besar, no incidents, fair weather) are irrelevant to a no-show case and do not explain the driver's position [F13][F14][F15]. The driver's written statement that he pressed "I'm Here" and waited more than 3 minutes at the pickup is a claim contradicted by the GPS and timeline records, which prevail [F12][F3][F5][NS-1].
